name: agent-cli-execution-receipt-reconciliation-e4e6
instr:
Give callers a durable, correlated account of an order from strategy intent through routing, venue attempts, fills, accounting, and recovery. One execution identity must explain what was requested, submitted, accepted, and applied without changing established direct, routed, dry-run, or TWAP results.

Routing preserves requested TIF and order type alongside stable identity while exposing the selected TIF without implying submission, rejection, or fill; existing wide-spread passive and high-urgency IOC selections remain unchanged, and venues without ALO expose their fallback selection without a placement outcome. Placement evidence records normalized submissions and ordered fallback attempts, including rejections, while only genuine fills become accepted quantities. `OrderManager` from `cli.order_manager` returns receipts in originating-decision order for placed direct and child decisions, retaining rejected receipts and omitting skipped decisions. Parent and TWAP progress retain partial fills, accept each child execution identity at most once, and complete only when distinct accepted child quantities reach the parent target; positions, risk, statistics, and trade history consume each accepted execution identity once; identical repeats are duplicates, while contradictory repeats raise `ReconciliationConflict` from `execution.reconciliation` before changing state.
